CursorPagination.description: CursorPagination passes a cursor extracted from each response.

cursor.description: Cursor is a CEL expression extracting the next cursor; empty or null stops.

header.description: Header carrying the cursor, instead of a query parameter.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

pageSizeParam.description: PageSizeParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

param.description: Param is the query parameter carrying the cursor.

Estimate.description: Estimate gives hints to the planner.

pagesPerRun.description: PagesPerRun is the expected number of pages per run.

ExpressionPagination.description: ExpressionPagination computes the next request with CEL.

next.description: Next is a CEL expression returning {query: {...}} for the next page, or null.

Extract.description: Extract maps responses to samples and inventory items.

filter.description: Filter is a CEL expression on item; false skips the item.

info.description: Info metrics (value 1, descriptive labels) produced per item.

inventory.description: Inventory items produced per item (role inventory or both).

items.description:
Items is a CEL expression returning the list of items of a page.
Default: response.body when it is a list.

partial.description: Partial emits the samples of a run even when a later page fails.

post.description: Post metrics computed once per run over all pages (responses).

ForEach.description: ForEach fans a job out over the inventory items of a parent job.

filter.description: Filter is a CEL expression on parent selecting a subset of items.

job.description: Job is the parent Job (same account), for inline jobs.

maxInstances.description: MaxInstances caps the fan-out, against runaway discovery.

template.description:
Template is the parent JobTemplate, instantiated implicitly for the
account when no job references it.

vars.description: Vars maps request variables to CEL expressions on parent.

InfoMetric.description: InfoMetric produces an _info metric: value 1 and descriptive labels.

labels.description: Labels maps label names to CEL expressions returning strings.

name.description: Name of the metric, ending with _info.

skipIf.description: SkipIf is a CEL expression; true skips the sample.

Inventory.description: Inventory produces inventory items for child jobs.

fields.description: Fields maps field names to CEL expressions, available as parent.<field>.

key.description: Key is a CEL expression returning the unique key of an item.

ttl.description: TTL of cached items. Default: 3x the job's effective interval.

JobTemplateSpec.description: JobTemplateSpec is the specification of a JobTemplate.

defaultInterval.description: DefaultInterval is the desired interval of jobs using the template.

defaultPriority.description: DefaultPriority of jobs using the template.

estimate.description: Estimate gives hints to the planner before run history exists.

extract.description: Extract maps responses to samples and inventory items.

forEach.description: ForEach fans the job out over the inventory items of a parent.

role.description: Role of the job: inventory items, metrics, or both.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

pageSizeParam.description: PageSizeParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

rel.description: Rel is the link relation of the next page.

Metric.description: Metric maps items to samples of one metric.

accumulate.description:
Accumulate sums successive window values into a persisted counter
(type counter only).

labels.description: Labels maps label names to CEL expressions returning strings.

name.description: Name of the metric (Prometheus naming rules).

skipIf.description: SkipIf is a CEL expression; true skips the sample.

timestamp.description: Timestamp is a CEL expression returning the source timestamp.

unit.description: Unit of the metric, preferably a Prometheus base unit.

value.description: Value is a CEL expression returning a number or a bool.

windowField.description:
WindowField is a CEL expression identifying the window of a value,
used by accumulate to avoid counting a window twice.

description.description: Description is free text for humans.

name.description: Name of the document, unique per kind.

OffsetPagination.description: OffsetPagination requests pages by item offset.

limitParam.description: LimitParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

offsetParam.description: OffsetParam is the query parameter carrying the offset.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

stop.description: Stop is a CEL expression; pagination stops when it returns true.

total.description: Total is a CEL expression returning the total number of items.

PagePagination.description: PagePagination requests pages by page number.

pageParam.description: PageParam is the query parameter carrying the page number.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

sizeParam.description: SizeParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

start.description: Start is the first page number.

stop.description: Stop is a CEL expression; pagination stops when it returns true.

total.description: Total is a CEL expression returning the total number of items.

Pagination.description: Pagination configures how successive pages are requested.

expression.description: Expression pagination computed by CEL (type expression).

linkHeader.description: LinkHeader pagination following RFC 8288 Link headers (type link_header).

maxPages.description: MaxPages is a hard safety cap on pages per run.

Request.description: Request describes the HTTP request of a job.

body.description:
Body is a JSON object for POST queries; values are literals, secrets or
CEL expressions.

headers.description: Headers merged over the provider defaults (the job wins).

method.description: Method of the request. POST is allowed only for read-only queries.

path.description:
Path relative to the base URL, with {var} placeholders resolved from
discovery variables, target params and account params.

query.description: Query parameters; values are literals, secrets or CEL expressions.

readOnly.description: ReadOnly must be true for POST requests: Tapyr never writes to providers.

timeout.description: Timeout of a single request. Defaults to the provider default.

Value.description: A literal string, {secret: name} or {expr: cel}.

secret.description: Name of a secret declared by the provider and supplied by the account.

description: A reusable job definition shipped by a provider package.
title: JobTemplate
